title: Flip your ₹100 note: Rani ki Vav, the stepwell that was buried for centuries
concept: Documentary Reel (36 s). Hook: flip your ₹100 note (3D card flip on frame one). A queen built it for her king (usually the reverse); an upside-down temple 7 storeys deep; the Saraswati's silt buried and preserved it; found in the 1940s, UNESCO 2014.
